results.question: 查询水位站宝应最近30天水位数据。
results.expected_sql:
SELECT DATE(r.tm) AS '日期', ROUND(AVG(r.z), 2) AS '水位(m)'
FROM sl323.st_river_r r
JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON r.stcd = b.stcd
WHERE b.stnm LIKE '%宝应%' AND b.sttp = 'ZZ'
  AND r.tm >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  AND r.z IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATE(r.tm)
ORDER BY DATE(r.tm);
actual_sqls:
SELECT DISTINCT b.stcd, b.stnm, b.sttp, b.rvnm, b.dtmnm
FROM st_stbprp_b b
WHERE b.stnm LIKE '%宝应%'
LIMIT 20
SELECT MAX(tm) AS max_tm FROM st_river_r WHERE stcd = '51005000'

SELECT 
    DATE(r.tm) AS dt,
    ROUND(AVG(r.z), 2) AS avg_z,
    ROUND(MIN(r.z), 2) AS min_z,
    ROUND(MAX(r.z), 2) AS max_z,
    COUNT(*) AS obs_cnt
FROM st_river_r r
WHERE r.stcd = '51005000'
  AND r.tm >= DATE_SUB('2026-07-31', INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  AND r.z IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATE(r.tm)
ORDER BY dt

SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(r.z), 2) AS period_avg,
    ROUND(MIN(r.z), 2) AS period_min,
    ROUND(MAX(r.z), 2) AS period_max,
    COUNT(*) AS total_obs
FROM st_river_r r
WHERE r.stcd = '51005000'
  AND r.tm >= DATE_SUB('2026-07-31', INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  AND r.z IS NOT NULL
